scenarios.query: Scaffold a Mantine admin dashboard with dark mode and analytics widgets
expected_behavior: Routes to designer-dashboards and activates designer-dashboards:init.
Reads rules/AGENTS.md guardrails before generating code.
Selects the react-vite-mantine stack profile from templates/tech-stacks/catalog.json or calls design_dashboards.
Uses scripts/scaffold-starter.mjs and verifies output with scripts/verify-dashboard.mjs.

scenarios.query: Harden my dashboard login page with 2FA, RBAC guards, and proper cookie settings
expected_behavior: Routes to designer-dashboards:login and consults references/05-auth-and-security.md.
Applies HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite cookie defaults, fail-closed authority guards, and real auth adapter options.
Avoids cosmetic localStorage-only auth or client-exposed secret env vars.
